    <item>
  <title>Sandisk Details Growth Strategy and Long-Term Financial Model at 2026 Investor Day</title>
  <link>https://investor.sandisk.com/news-releases/news-release-details/sandisk-details-growth-strategy-and-long-term-financial-model</link>
  <description><span class="field field--name-title field--type-string field--label-hidden">Sandisk Details Growth Strategy and Long-Term Financial Model at 2026 Investor Day</span>
<span class="field field--name- field--type-entity-reference field--label-hidden"><span>Content Import</span></span>
<span class="field field--name-created field--type-created field--label-hidden"><time datetime="2026-08-13T10:59:27-04:00" title="Thu, 08/13/2026 - 10:59" timezone="America/New_York" class="datetime">Thu, 08/13/2026 - 10:59</time>
</span>

<div class="field field--name-field-nir-news-title field--type-string field--label-hidden">
        <div class="field__item">Sandisk Details Growth Strategy and Long-Term Financial Model at 2026 Investor Day</div>
    </div>

<div class="field field--name-field-nir-news-date field--type-datetimezone field--label-hidden">
          <div class="field__item">August 13, 2026</div>
          </div>

<div class="field field--name-field-nir-news-type field--type-entity-reference field--label-hidden">
        <div class="field__item"><a href="https://investor.sandisk.com/taxonomy/term/3886" hreflang="en">General</a></div>
    </div>
      <ul class="bwlistdisc">
<li>
<i>Leading NAND technology roadmap and durable customer partnerships to drive sustainable long-term value</i>

</li>
<li>
<i>Financial model from FY2028 through FY2030 optimized for growth, sustainability and shareholder return</i>

</li>
<li>
<i>Company expects to return 100 percent of excess cash to shareholders after investing in the business</i>

</li>
</ul>
<p>    <location value="LU/us.ny.nyc" idsrc="xmltag.org">NEW YORK</location>--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Aug. 13, 2026--
Sandisk (Nasdaq: SNDK) today highlighted its long-term growth strategy and sustainable long-term financial model at its 2026 Investor Day, Sandisk In Focus. At the event, Sandisk outlined key areas of product and technology innovation and developments in its business model. A replay of the presentation will be available on Sandisk’s <a rel="nofollow" href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&amp;url=http%3A%2F%2Finvestor.sandisk.com%2F&amp;esheet=54588815&amp;newsitemid=20260813469901&amp;
